__comment: Task scheduler tunables (doc 16 First Dwarf Milestone, §2). Loaded by the
TaskManager autoload — no other script reads this file (Registry Pattern).
JSON = what things are (the numbers); GDScript = what things do (the loop).
NO-HANG CONTRACT (doc 16 §2.5 — these keys ARE the guarantees):
scheduler_budget_usec   - hard time budget per scheduler wake; the matching
loop stops mid-scan when exceeded and resumes from
its cursor on the next wake. Overload degrades into
assignment LATENCY, never frame time.
max_probes_per_wake     - reachability search slices per wake, whichever limit hits
first. Probes are the only non-trivial loop cost.
probe_node_cap          - A* expansions per search slice (currently 1200).
Unfinished searches resume on the next wake; only
a failed full search applies unreachable backoff.
heartbeat_interval_s    - slow safety-net poll; normal operation is
event-driven wakes (task added, dwarf idle, ...).
backoff_base_s / backoff_max_s - unreachable-task retry curve:
min(backoff_base^blocked_count, backoff_max).
unreachable_signal_threshold - consecutive blocked probes before
task_unreachable fires (doc 31: 3).
static_priorities       - per-type base priority (doc 31 table). Stored on
the task at creation; colony bonuses are computed
per wake per TYPE and never written into tasks.
Keys beginning with '__' are documentation comments and are skipped.

grilling.__comment: Grilling a fresh fish at a burning campfire (doc 290), read by DwarfFoodBehavior. The fish browns after browned_at of grill_seconds (real seconds at x1, as eat_seconds), then is eaten off the stick. The meal adds rest to the Rest (sleep) meter; the sheet says Rested by the fire for rested_hours game hours after.

spoilage.__comment: Food spoilage (doc 42 'Spoilage', doc 282), read by StockpileManager's FoodSpoilage. A stack's spoil runs 0 to 1, gaining speed / (24 x keeps_days) each game hour (keeps_days per food in resources.json). speed = rate_per_10c ^ ((T - reference_c) / 10) at the place's temperature T; frozen_speed under a roof at or below temperature.json's frozen_at_c; open sky adds open_sky_speed, or wet_speed in rain, storm or snow. At 1 the unclaimed units rot; Events warns as a stack passes warn_at. The readouts call a stack Fresh below spoiling_at, Spoiling below warn_at, then Going bad, and Frozen while it keeps at frozen_speed. Crates further apart in spoil than merge_band stay apart: a deposit tops up a crate of like freshness, else takes an empty cell, and only with no empty cell tops up the crate closest in freshness; fresh harvest never joins a loose crate spoilt past it, nor a hauler's basket a crate further off. The food search prefers older food: a fully spoilt stack counts route_margin_blocks nearer. The hourly pass spends at most budget_usec a frame.

__comment_fishing: Fishing (doc 289). waters: each generated water a zone can fish, its catch and name, in the order a cast cell is matched (the lake, the tarn, the spring cave's pool, then the river). Its stock is stock_per_cell fish for each cell of it: the lake's and tarn's surface columns (lake 12,000-27,000, so 150-330 perch; a tarn about 900, so 60 char), the river's columns (2,000-3,200, so 60-95 trout) and the spring cave's water cells (31-37, so about 20 cave fish). It regrows regrowth_per_day of that maximum a day, continuously. Below fished_out_share of its maximum a water is Fished out and its zones post no work. A catch takes catch_hours of game time on a full water in spring, divided by season_speed, up to low_stock_factor times as long near Fished out, give or take catch_spread (seeded); Wisdom speeds it (stats.json). A zone keeps keep_default fish in store unless changed, by keep_step up to keep_max. A spot needs water at least min_depth deep within reach blocks of it, from its feet down to bank_drop blocks below them.
__comment_hauling: Stockpile hauling. max_haulers_per_zone: maximum concurrent HAUL leases per storage source. carry_capacity: total carry_cost points per trip. Costs are authored per item in resources.json: stone, ore and raw timber 1, produce/furniture crates 4. Crate cost is per physical crate, regardless of quantity inside. Matching edible produce may be consolidated into that one crate up to its item capacity. fruit_detour_blocks bounds total extra route steps; fruit_planning_budget_usec, fruit_probe_nodes, fruit_route_cells and fruit_candidate_limit bound optional route pickup planning. Other items cost 1. carry_speed_mult_heavy: walking multiplier when the reserved load includes any weight_class 'heavy' item, independent of carry cost. pouch_bundle_radius: extras must be within this many blocks of the main item. pickup_time_s / deposit_time_s: handling duration at normal clock speed.
__comment_furniture: FETCH_BUILD 45 > HAUL 40: player placement outranks storage. Ordinary finished furniture installs during hauling.deposit_time_s, with no separate build wait. Ladders and plants own their animated assembly/planting duration. uninstall_time_s remains the ordinary removal work duration. wall_reach_up_blocks: maximum bracket-cell height above a walkable floor for both wall-light installation and removal; clear reach and normal dwarf headroom are still required.
__comment_idle: Interruptible leisure while available for work. Seconds follow simulation speed. Walks stay on clear same-level ground near the last work/spawn position; no ladders or long-distance roaming. Chairs remain separately built furniture.

health.__comment: Dwarf health (doc 41), read by DwarfHealth. Whole hit points: base_hit_points at Average in `stat`, per_step more or less for each step above or below. Healing is a share of the maximum each game hour, asleep or awake. Words by the share left: Healthy at hurt_below and above, Hurt down to badly_hurt_below, Badly hurt under it, which also brings the Injured thought (injured_mood_penalty). Nothing hurts a dwarf yet, and health never drops below `minimum` points; dev_hurt is what DEV: hurt a dwarf takes.

mood.__comment_steps: Five words for happiness, read by DwarfMood. Each step holds happiness points (0-100) up to and including `most`; the last holds the rest. Unhappy and Miserable are when the face shows over a dwarf's head. `icon` is the step's Hearthblock face (doc 261).

steps.line: Nothing is going right down here.
Something down here is wearing on them.
Getting by, neither up nor down.
Things are going well down here.
Life underground could hardly be better.

grilled.__comment: A fish grilled and eaten at a campfire (doc 290): alone, or with another dwarf grilling or sitting at the same fire. Only the stronger counts.

room_appeal.__comment: After a sleep, a meal or a game in a sealed room, the room's appeal word gives its points (data/rooms/appeal.json) for these game hours (doc 41). The next sleep, meal or game replaces it.

hauling.__comment_route_cache: Bounded shared pickup/delivery searches. Identical geometry resumes across leases and stock changes; navigation changes invalidate proofs. Evicted leases retain their own unfinished frontier. pickup_search_cells: one pickup search ends at whichever of this many nearest loads lying the same way it reaches first (StorageComponent.pickup_group).
